title: Espinacas con garbanzos (spinach with chickpeas)
steps: Fry the bread and garlic in the oil until golden, remove and pound in a mortar with the paprika, cumin and vinegar to a paste.
Wilt the spinach in the same pan.
Add the chickpeas, diced tofu, stock and paste and simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and serve warm.
